name: edit_file
description: Changes a file by replacing an exact piece of its text: pass path, old (the exact text to replace, copied from the file) and new. The match must be unique, so include enough surrounding lines to identify one place; the tool tells you how many times it matched rather than guessing. Pass create: true with content to write a whole new file; that is refused if the path already exists unless you also pass overwrite: true, so a guessed filename cannot quietly erase something. Read the file first with read_file: text reconstructed from memory usually differs in whitespace and will not match.
llm_description: Replace exact text in a file: {path, old, new}. old must match exactly once (copy verbatim from read_file first; reconstructed text rarely matches whitespace). Empty new deletes the match. {create:true, content} writes a new file; refused if path exists unless overwrite:true.

path.description: File to change, relative to the sandbox root.

old.description: Exact text to replace, copied from the file including indentation. Must occur exactly once.

new.description: Text to put in its place. Empty string deletes the matched text.

create.description: Write a whole new file from content. Refused if the path already exists, unless overwrite is also set.

content.description: Whole file text, used with create.

overwrite.description: With create, replace an existing file's entire contents. Prefer old/new, which changes only what you name.
